units.source_text: “第三座神龛里供的是托尔斯泰的半身像。

en.t: In the third shrine was enshrined a bust of Tolstoy.

units.source_text: 这位圣徒的修行比其他人都艰苦。

en.t: This saint's ascetic practice was harder than anyone else's.

units.source_text: 他原来是个贵族，不希望被满是好奇心的公众看到自己的痛苦。

en.t: He had originally been an aristocrat, and did not want the curious public to see his suffering.

units.source_text: 这位圣徒努力去信仰实际上并不能相信的基督，

en.t: This saint struggled to believe in a Christ whom, in truth, he could not believe in,

units.source_text: 他曾经一度公开宣称他无比坚持自己的信仰。

en.t: and at one time he publicly declared that he held fast to his faith with absolute conviction.

units.source_text: 直到晚年，他终于不堪忍受做一个悲壮撒谎者了。

en.t: In his later years, he finally could no longer endure being a tragic liar.

units.source_text: 他常常对书斋的房梁感到恐惧，这件事是非常有名的。

en.t: It is very well known that he was often afraid of the beams in his study.

units.source_text: 不过他不曾选择自杀，否则他就成不了圣徒了。”

en.t: But he never chose suicide; otherwise, he could not have become a saint.
